description: This Kotlin source file provides utility functions for handling diagnostics and status reporting related to the OpenClaw Android gateway connection. It includes functions to generate diagnostic reports and copy them to the clipboard, as well as functions to interpret gateway statuses for display or conditional logic.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a version label string for the current Android app, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and version name is not already marked as development.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version of the status text or 'Offline' if empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Checks if the current gateway status indicates it has diagnostics, i.e., not offline and not connecting.

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Determines whether the status text suggests the gateway is in a pairing or approval process.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Builds a detailed diagnostics report string containing device, OS version, gateway address, status, and instructions for troubleshooting.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the generated diagnostics report to the system clipboard and shows a toast notification.
